purpose: Rc process-graph parity matrix for Star 9
rule: Pipelines, jobs, rfork, notes, and wait must be represented through Star 9 tasks, fd tables, pipes, namespaces, env files, and device files. Host shell side channels are not acceptable.

layers.portable_evaluator: crates/star9-rc keeps deterministic captured execution for fake hosts, browser-limited hosts, and pure built-ins.
layers.star9_adapter: crates/star9-shell/src/rc.rs implements process-graph prepare/finish hooks over Star 9 task and fd surfaces.
layers.future_external_streaming: Concurrent streaming external process graphs remain future work behind Star 9 execution providers.

features.notes: The reusable rc crate exposes host-neutral graph specs and records without depending on Star 9 runtime types.

The Star 9 adapter creates per-stage task records, standard fds, and selected pipe fd bindings under .rc/graphs. Stage execution is still the deterministic evaluator path unless an external provider handles streaming execution.
<{} and >{} remain evaluator data paths for portability, while the Star 9 adapter now creates task/fd graph records that expose the intended pipe endpoint.
Background jobs have stable rc job ids and support wait or wait <job>. The Star 9 adapter records task graph state for the job. Full task-group scheduling remains future work.
Captured stdout/stderr redirection, fd dup/close, and process-substitution sink handling are implemented. Full arbitrary fd-table graph streaming through external task providers remains future work.
rfork e is accepted through the host boundary. Namespace/env/fd/process-group sharing flags remain precisely rejected until Star 9 has matching process scope controls.
sigexit and rc note functions work. The Star 9 adapter attempts to broadcast notes through #signal/data when present. Delivery to concurrent task groups remains future work.
Browser rc keeps deterministic evaluator behavior unless a worker-backed task/fd graph provider is explicitly added. Raw native process semantics are not a browser capability.
